name: urban_materials

provenance.electromagnetic_model: Sionna built-in ITU radio-material models based on ITU-R P.2040

limitations: OSM tags do not measure facade, roof, asphalt, soil-moisture, or vegetation electromagnetic properties.
Road=concrete and water=wet-ground are explicit compatibility proxies for Sionna 1.2.1, not identified physical composition.
Material sensitivity profiles and external or field validation are required before physical-verification claims.
